title: Ask anything about living and working in Switzerland as a foreign national
intro: Residence and work permits, registration, family reunification, social insurance when leaving, tax at source, driving licences and vehicles, health insurance and naturalisation, the Zurich offices, and daily life in the City of Zurich: waste and recycling, parking, dogs, kindergarten, the tax return and the radio and TV fee. Federal rules, with the procedures of the Canton of Zurich and the City of Zurich.
note: Answers come from reviewed facts of official sources and cite them. Ask in English or German.
questions: When is the Road Traffic Office in Zurich open, and do I need an appointment?
I'm moving to the city of Zurich with my dog. What do I have to do for the dog?
Which rubbish bags do I have to use in the city of Zurich, and when is the rubbish collected?
I'm a Czech citizen and start working in Zurich next week. By when at the latest do I have to register?
I have had a B permit since March 2022 and work in Zurich. My 13-year-old son still lives in Pristina. Can he join me now?
I arrived in Zurich from Canada two months ago on a B permit and have no health insurance yet. Is it too late, and from when will I pay?
Ich habe eine B-Bewilligung, arbeite in Zürich und heirate nächsten Monat einen Schweizer. Werde ich weiterhin an der Quelle besteuert?
